headline: GOLD REBOUNDS TOWARD $3,960 ON ELECTION MORNING — WORST OCTOBER SINCE 2008 NOW BACKDROP FOR MACRO DOUBLE-HEADER
snippet: Spot gold bounced to near $3,957 on Tuesday, recovering from a low of $3,875 that marked gold's worst monthly performance since 2008. With U.S. midterm election results incoming and non-farm payrolls on Friday, analysts say bulls need both events to cooperate before any sustained recovery.

headline: COCHILCO SLASHES CHILE 2026 COPPER OUTPUT FORECAST 8.4% — ESCONDIDA AND CODELCO DRIVE MISS; PRICE LIFTED TO $6.18/LB
snippet: Chile's state copper commission Cochilco cut its 2026 production forecast to 4.94 million tonnes, a steeper-than-expected 8.4% decline versus prior estimates of -2.6%, with BHP's Escondida and Spence and Codelco mines accounting for more than 77% of the net output shortfall. Cochilco simultaneously raised its 2026 average copper price forecast to $6.18 per pound on constrained supply.

headline: ASX GOLD MINERS LEAD NOVEMBER 3 RECOVERY AS OIL PLUNGES 8% — RELIEF RALLY EXPECTED TO CARRY TO TSX
snippet: Australian gold equities were among the strongest performers on the ASX on Tuesday as oil prices fell sharply, easing inflation fears and supporting precious metals. The move was expected to flow through to TSX-listed gold names when North American markets opened, providing a rare positive session for a sector that has been under pressure for weeks.

headline: I-80 GOLD Q3: 36,000m DRILLED IN NEVADA — ARCHIMEDES UNDERGROUND MINE ON TRACK FOR YEAR-END PRODUCTION START
snippet: i-80 Gold (TSX: IAU) drilled approximately 36,000 metres across its Nevada operations in Q3 2026, with encouraging infill and step-out results expanding the Archimedes open-pit potential beyond the 2025 PEA shell. The Archimedes underground mine remains on schedule to begin production mining by year-end 2026, a key milestone for the Nevada-focused gold developer.

headline: GORDON MINING COMPLETES ACQUISITION OF TUNGSTEN TAIL PROJECT IN NEW MEXICO — CRITICAL MINERAL FOR HARDENED STEEL AND DEFENSE
snippet: Gordon Mining completed its acquisition of 100% of TT Minerals LLC, holder of the Tungsten Tail Project in Sierra County, New Mexico, from Lamina Minerals LLC. Tungsten is a critical mineral used in hardened steel, defense applications and semiconductor manufacturing, and domestic U.S. tungsten supply remains tightly controlled by Chinese producers.

headline: CRITICAL METALS CORP / EUROPEAN LITHIUM MERGER CLEARS WA SUPREME COURT — NASDAQ DEBUT SET FOR NOVEMBER 6
snippet: Critical Metals Corp's reverse merger with European Lithium was approved by the Supreme Court of Western Australia, with implementation set for November 5 and new shares expected to begin trading on Nasdaq on November 6, 2026. The deal creates a Nasdaq-listed European lithium explorer at a time when Western supply chain independence is under heightened scrutiny.

headline: LOTUS RESOURCES SHIPS FIRST URANIUM ORE FROM KAYELEKERA MINE IN MALAWI — LANDMARK RESTART MILESTONE
snippet: Lotus Resources confirmed the first uranium ore shipment has departed its Kayelekera uranium mine in Malawi, marking a significant production milestone for the restart project. Kayelekera is one of the few uranium mines resuming operations outside the traditional Athabasca Basin and Kazakhstan supply chains, adding African uranium to the global production mix.

headline: NEU HORIZON URANIUM DEFINES DRILL TARGETS AT ALL 4 KROKOM PROSPECTS IN SWEDEN — DRILLING IMMINENT
snippet: ASX-listed Neu Horizon Uranium (ASX: NHU) has completed geological surveys and defined drill targets at all four Krokom uranium prospects in Sweden ahead of its maiden drill program. Sweden lifted its prohibition on uranium extraction effective January 1, 2026, making Nordic uranium exploration an emerging junior mining theme.

headline: EU EXPANDS MANDATORY BATTERY RECYCLING — NEW RULES TARGET LITHIUM, NICKEL AND COBALT DOMESTIC SECURITY
snippet: The European Union expanded mandatory battery recycling requirements in its latest regulatory update, setting binding recovered-content targets for lithium, nickel and cobalt. The rules are designed to reduce European dependence on Chinese-processed battery materials and create a structural tailwind for domestic secondary processors and junior miners with European projects.

headline: B2GOLD REPORTS NOVEMBER 4 — Q3 RESULTS FIRST MAJOR EARNINGS TEST FOR JUNIOR GOLD MINERS IN ELECTION WEEK
snippet: B2Gold (TSX: BTO) is scheduled to release Q3 2026 results on November 4, making it the first significant mid-tier gold producer to report during a week defined by U.S. election uncertainty and Friday payrolls. Analysts are watching the results as a sentiment gauge for the junior gold sector, which has been testing two-year relative lows against spot gold prices.
